mechanism: Doxycycline is a tetracycline antibiotic that can inhibit monoamine oxidase activity and may potentiate the MAOI effects of isocarboxazid, increasing risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis; additionally, tetracyclines have mild MAOI-like properties that compound this risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use only with careful monitoring and patient education on hypertensive crisis symptoms; consider alternative antibiotics without MAOI properties.
